settings.intro: Transparent flats, coral islands and a varied Caribbean fly fishery.

settings.heading: Explore the fishing.
settings.intro: Wade clear Caribbean flats for bonefish, permit and tarpon across the islands and cays of the Los Roques Archipelago.

settings.heading: A world of flats
settings.text: Explore shallow flats and island edges on foot or with a guide, from Gran Roque across the archipelago.

settings.heading: Beyond bonefish
settings.text: Bonefish are the signature target; permit, tarpon, snook, jacks, barracuda and triggerfish add variety.

settings.heading: Fish year-round
settings.text: The legacy guide describes year-round fishing, with different windows favoring bonefish and larger tarpon.

settings.heading: Plan your next trip.
settings.text: Tell us your preferred window. Our team will confirm current departures and arrangements.
